text:
Ivy Chen: Postmortem follow-up — recurring cache evictions tied to nightly batch imports. Need clear owners for runbook edits, quick playbook cheatsheet for oncall, and an alert to catch the pattern before evictions.
Diego Ramos: I can do the playbook cheatsheet and pasteable commands. Will finish by Tue.
Diego Ramos: Commands I plan to add:
```bash
# node memory and pod hot list
kubectl top nodes | awk '{print $1, $5}' | sort -k2 -nr
kubectl top pods -n inference | grep kv-cache
# tail recent cache logs
kubectl logs -n inference deploy/kv-cache --since=15m --tail=200
```
Harper: I'll own the alert (Prometheus -> Grafana). Suggest two-stage alert: warning at 5 evictions/min, critical at 20 evictions/min aggregated across cache pods. Draft by Fri.
runbook-bot: Created ticket INC-2510: "Runbook + alerting for nightly cache eviction spikes" assigned to Harper, due 2026-04-10.
Ivy Chen: Add immediate mitigation steps to runbook: 1) reduce batch_size for affected routes, 2) rotate cache deployment, 3) promote smaller model variant for heavy routes. Example commands to include:
```bash
redwood route set --route /v1/generate --batch_size 4 --reason 'mitigation'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-cache -n inference
redwood route promote --route /v1/generate --variant small --reason 'eviction-failover'
```
Vik: I'll draft an RFC for job gating/staggering on the data side and link it to INC-2510. Target RFC ready in 1 week.
Diego Ramos: I'll also add an "Escalation" section: page infra-oncall -> platform -> SRE lead, include phone numbers and who to cc in the incident doc.
Ivy Chen: Owner summary (please add to INC-2510): playbook cheatsheet: Diego Ramos 3 2026-03-31; alert/dashboard: Harper 3 2026-04-02; RFC for gating: Vik 3 2026-04-06; runbook review/merge: Ivy + Diego 3 2026-03-30.
Harper: ack. I'll post the alert rule as a PR to monitoring-configs and ping Diego for dashboard panel copy.
Vik: I'll include pre-flight health check for bulk jobs (query eviction rate before starting) in the RFC.
Ivy Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll check back next Wednesday. If anything slips, call it out in the ticket."
